crossRefs.note: Menahem slept with his fathers, and Pekahiah his son reigned in his place.

parallels.note: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.

people.name: Menahem
people.line: King of Israel who reigned for ten years.

people.name: Pekahiah
people.line: King of Israel who reigned for 2 years

translations.kjv: And Menahem slept with his fathers; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead.
translations.asv: And Menahem slept with his fathers; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead.
